ov: حدث في ليلة ما (الإنجليزية: It Happened One Night) هو فيلم رومانسي أمريكي صدر في سنة 1934. الفيلم من إخراج فرانك كابرا. ومن بطولة كلارك غيبل، كلوديت كولبيرت
plotEn:
Wall Street heiress Ellie Andrews has eloped with glamorous pilot King Westley. Her father, who considers Westley a fortune hunter, sequesters Ellie on his Florida yacht while his lawyers arrange an annulment. Ellie escapes and swims to shore, where she boards a Greyhound bus bound for New York City to reunite with Westley. Mr. Andrews makes headlines by offering a $10,000 reward ($240,672 in 2025) for her safe return.
On the bus, Ellie meets Peter Warne, a newly unemployed newspaper reporter. Peter is annoyed by Ellie, who expects special treatment and lacks practical life skills. However, drawn to Ellie's strong personality, he helps her after a thief steals most of her money. During a scheduled stop in Jacksonville, Florida, Ellie misses the bus, wrongly assuming the driver would wait for her. Having read the headlines, Peter stays behind to accompany her, and they catch the evening bus that night.
On the evening bus, Ellie initially sits next to salesman Shapeley, who hits on her until Peter claims to be her husband. The bus is forced to stop for the night when a bridge washes out on the road, and Peter rents them a motel room together. He gives her an ultimatum: if she gives him an exclusive story, he will help her get to New York; otherwise, he will tell her father where she is. Ellie agrees to the story.
